title: 52-week-high proximity
summary: Score = current close / maximum daily high over those 252 sessions; rank highest first.
universe: Indian cash equities · current Nifty 500-derived panel

rules.entry: Use the latest 252 completed sessions of daily highs and the current completed close. Score = current close / maximum daily high over those 252 sessions; rank highest first. Choose up to 10 stocks. Review every six months, in January and July. No requirement for a fresh breakout.
rules.exit: Sell when removed at a review. No stop-loss or take-profit. Estimate terminal liquidation at final close.
rules.sizing: Up to 10 stocks. Signal equity / 10 per new position; fractional shares; retained positions are not resized.
rules.execution: Rank on a completed session. Sell removals at the next tradable open; buy additions at signal + 3 sessions.

limitations: Requires finite high history and positive signal-day volume. Intraday highs, not maximum closing prices, define the high. The published long/short implementation is not replicated.

title: Market-adjusted residual momentum
summary: Subtract fitted returns to obtain residuals. Select the 126 residual returns ending 21 sessions before the signal date.
universe: Indian cash equities · current Nifty 500-derived panel

rules.entry: Use 504 daily returns and fit stock return = intercept + beta × Nifty 500 return. Subtract fitted returns to obtain residuals. Select the 126 residual returns ending 21 sessions before the signal date. Score = sum of these residuals / their sample standard deviation; rank highest first. Choose up to 30 stocks and review quarterly.
rules.exit: Sell when removed at a review. No stop-loss or take-profit. Estimate terminal liquidation at final close.
rules.sizing: Up to 30 stocks. Signal equity / 30 per new position; fractional shares; retained positions are not resized.
rules.execution: Rank on a completed session. Sell removals at the next tradable open; buy additions at signal + 3 sessions.

limitations: Require complete 505-close history, positive current volume and nonzero residual volatility. No positive-score requirement. Market-only proxy, not the paper’s three-factor residual model.

title: Volatility-adjusted momentum ranking
summary: Compute sample standard deviation of the latest 126 daily returns, including the recent month, and multiply by sqrt(252).
universe: Indian cash equities · current Nifty 500-derived panel

rules.entry: Measure the 126-session price return ending 21 sessions before the signal: close at t−21 / close at t−147 − 1. Compute sample standard deviation of the latest 126 daily returns, including the recent month, and multiply by sqrt(252). Keep positive formation returns. Score = formation return / annualized volatility, highest first. Choose up to 10 stocks and review quarterly.

title: Industry-led momentum

universe: Indian cash equities · current Nifty 500-derived panel

Rank positive-return stocks within each group; alternate one stock from each group’s ranked list until up to 20 are selected. Review quarterly.

title: Continuous-information momentum
summary: In that same formation window, count fractions of up and down days. ID = sign(formation return) × (fraction down − fraction up). Zero-return days remain in the denominator.
universe: Indian cash equities · current Nifty 500-derived panel

rules.entry: Calculate the 126-session return ending 21 sessions before the signal. Rank eligible stocks and retain the top 20%, rounded up; keep only positive returns. In that same formation window, count fractions of up and down days. ID = sign(formation return) × (fraction down − fraction up). Zero-return days remain in the denominator. Rank lowest ID first, then highest formation return, then symbol. Choose up to 10 stocks and review monthly.

title: Moving-average distance trend
summary: Score = 50-session mean / 200-session mean; rank highest first. This is a ranked distance, not a fresh crossover signal.
universe: Indian cash equities · current Nifty 500-derived panel
